claims.summary: McShane describes argument omission in Russian repetition structures when consecutive clauses repeat the same verb and arguments; this entry is limited to that configuration rather than claiming arbitrary null subjects in coordination.

locator.label: § 4.2.3, pp. 121–122, lines 973–994: consecutive conjuncts/clauses with the same verb and selected arguments form repetition structures; arguments are normally elided unless overt repetition has a stylistic purpose.
